sources.entry: Shandian - Native download manager that handles magnet links, torrents, HTTP files and videos from YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin and Xiaohongshu in one window, with browser download takeover and stream-while-downloading (Chinese UI). [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/chenmozhe008/shandian-download) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: A native macOS download manager (Chinese UI) that handles magnet links, torrents, ed2k, HTTP files and videos from platforms like YouTube, Bilibili, Douyin and Xiaohongshu in one window.
summary.what_it_does: Shandian manages magnet links, torrents, ed2k, HTTP/HTTPS direct links, and video downloads from YouTube, X, Bilibili, Weibo, Douyin, Xiaohongshu and similar sites in a single window on macOS. Users paste a link with ⌘V or drag a torrent file in, and the link type is detected automatically. A browser extension (Chrome and Edge) hands in-page downloads to the app. The download engine is a patched version of Gopeed v1.9.3, and video platform downloads use yt-dlp. Features include multi-segment HTTP downloads, stream-while-downloading for movies, resume after restart, a per-domain proxy routing based on system settings, and a library that sorts completed items by category. An optional PikPak cloud offline feature can fetch slow BT resources server-side first.
use_cases: download magnet links and torrents on a mac
save videos from YouTube or Bilibili to a mac
download Douyin or Xiaohongshu videos without watermark
grab files from web pages through a browser extension
watch a movie while it downloads
offload slow torrents to a cloud service
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash  (command-line install, per README; URL missing from the README text)
Or download Shandian-版本号-AppleSilicon.zip or Shandian-版本号-Intel.zip from Releases and drag the app to Applications
brew install ffmpeg  (needed for video platform downloads)
swift build -c release  (build the app from source)
./script/build_app.sh package  (package into dist/闪电全能下载.app)
notable: Single window handles magnet, torrent, ed2k, HTTP and video-platform links with automatic type detection
Browser extension takes over downloads from web pages and sends Douyin, Xiaohongshu and Xinpianchang videos
Stream-while-downloading: play movies during download and prioritize seeked segments
Per-domain proxy routing: overseas sites via proxy, domestic sites and BT direct
Optional PikPak cloud offline download for BT resources with no seeders
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; separate builds for Apple Silicon and Intel
Not notarized by Apple, so first launch needs a manual approval step in System Settings
Video platform downloads need ffmpeg installed separately; WeChat Channels is not supported
PikPak cloud offline is unofficial and may break when PikPak changes its web interface; free account has daily limits
Build scripts contain hardcoded paths from the author's machine and must be edited before building from source
